name: Overclocked
description:
Overclocked is a collection of 3,000 animated CPUs pushed beyond their limits. Each chip is procedurally generated and fully animated.

**Mining Rig** — install your CPUs in the Mining Rig and they mine **Cycles** every second. A Common mines 2,400 Cycles per day and rarity multiplies it:

- Common · x1 · 2,400 Cycles/day
- Uncommon · x2.2 · 5,280 Cycles/day
- Rare · x3.6 · 8,640 Cycles/day
- Epic · x4.8 · 11,520 Cycles/day
- Legendary · x6 · 14,400 Cycles/day

No minimum time: unstake anytime and keep every Cycle already mined.

**Airdrop** — 30% of the token supply will be airdropped to stakers based on their Cycles.
